column1: # Probe: 40 swamp steps - does the party ever get poisoned?
# This is a lottery on the encounter probe. `encounters.md` Section 2: "Every
# turn the overworld mode loop runs its per-turn block", which rolls and
# compares against a tile-derived threshold, and on success "writes one new
# monster into the active-object table on a tile near the party". Forty swamp
# steps are forty of those rolls, and the two sides never share a seed - so a
# run where one side meets a monster and the other does not has measured the
# probe rather than the swamp. Measured 2026-09-10: the original spawned one
# and was in combat by the `after30` shot, showing its actor banner, while
# this engine was still walking and printing `Slow progress!`.
# The early beats are usually the comparable part, but not always: re-measured
# 2026-10-16 across the 21 stock runs since 2026-09-07, the original was already
# in its `SPIDERS` conflict by `after20` in three (2026-09-10 12:18, 2026-09-13
# 07:50, 2026-10-16 21:02), and by `after40` it had died to the fight and been
# rescued (`Strange words are intoned.`) in two. The rc1 engine run of
# 2026-10-16 22:44 met the spiders before `after20` while stock that run did
# not. Every one of those windows has the same shape on both sides - only which
# turn the probe fires on differs - so a difference here is the probe, not the
# The fight itself is a lottery too. `formats/cbt.md` Section 6 picks the
# outdoor arena from the world tile under the triggering monster, and the
# spiders roam the swamp/grass edge, so either side can fight in the swamp
# arena (whose tiles poison on contact) or the grass one, and either side can
# then be poisoned, killed and rescued by `after40`: the stock in two runs
# before 2026-10-16 and in 20261023-101254, the engine in the rc7 sweep
# (20261023-002954). Each beat's row shape still agrees; only who was hit
# differs. Arenas seen: engine swamp/stock grass (1016-210214, rc7 sweep),
# both grass (1016-224432). The stock has not yet been seen in the swamp arena;
# if a run shows the engine in it while the triggering spider stands on grass,
# that is the arena pick to check, not this lottery.
# Seeded rather than walked to. The walk-up form of this scenario scripted its
# way in from the town gate, and the resident walks its own schedule while
# those steps run, so the two sides arrived with it in different cells and
# every later beat compared unrelated windows (`cleak/u5-engine#22`).
# `qa/tools/reseed.py` replayed that walk once into the seed named below.
